mapper.select:
SELECT CA.*,
FROM CONTENT_ASSOC CA JOIN CONTENT_ASSOC PRN ON PRN.CONTENT_ID_TO = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO WHERE CA.CONTENT_ID_TO = #{contentIdTo} AND CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'TREE_CHILD' AND (PRN.FROM_DATE IS NULL OR CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= PRN.FROM_DATE) AND (PRN.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < PRN.THRU_DATE)
mapper.sql: ${alias}.CONTENT_ID AS ${alias}_CONTENT_ID, ${alias}.CONTENT_ID_TO AS ${alias}_CONTENT_ID_TO, ${alias}.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID AS ${alias}_CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID, ${alias}.FROM_DATE AS ${alias}_FROM_DATE, ${alias}.THRU_DATE AS ${alias}_THRU_DATE, ${alias}.CONTENT_ASSOC_PREDICATE_ID AS ${alias}_CONTENT_ASSOC_PREDICATE_ID, ${alias}.DATA_SOURCE_ID AS ${alias}_DATA_SOURCE_ID, ${alias}.SEQUENCE_NUM AS ${alias}_SEQUENCE_NUM, ${alias}.MAP_KEY AS ${alias}_MAP_KEY, ${alias}.UPPER_COORDINATE AS ${alias}_UPPER_COORDINATE, ${alias}.LEFT_COORDINATE AS ${alias}_LEFT_COORDINATE, ${alias}.CREATED_DATE AS ${alias}_CREATED_DATE, ${alias}.CREATED_BY_USER_LOGIN AS ${alias}_CREATED_BY_USER_LOGIN, ${alias}.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE AS ${alias}_LAST_MODIFIED_DATE, ${alias}.LAST_MODIFIED_BY_USER_LOGIN AS ${alias}_LAST_MODIFIED_BY_USER_LOGIN, ${alias}.LAST_UPDATED_STAMP AS ${alias}_LAST_UPDATED_STAMP, ${alias}.LAST_UPDATED_TX_STAMP AS ${alias}_LAST_UPDATED_TX_STAMP, ${alias}.CREATED_STAMP AS ${alias}_CREATED_STAMP, ${alias}.CREATED_TX_STAMP AS ${alias}_CREATED_TX_STAMP
